stock.description: Yues International Holdings Group Limited operates as an investment holding entity, providing a comprehensive suite of logistics solutions to support client supply chains across the People's Republic of China. Its business activities are structured into four distinct areas: Transportation Service, Warehousing Service, In-Plant Logistics Service, and Customisation Service. The Transportation Service segment facilitates the movement of production inputs, components, and finished goods, in addition to offering maritime shipping and international freight forwarding representation. The Warehousing Service division is responsible for inventory storage and meticulous management. Through its In-Plant Logistics Service, the company delivers on-site support directly within client manufacturing facilities, overseeing the internal flow of materials, components, and work-in-progress to production lines, and the subsequent transfer of finished products to factory exits. Furthermore, the Customisation Service segment provides value-added services such as labelling and bundling. Yues serves a diverse clientele across various industries, including significant players in the beverage, textile, and pharmaceutical sectors. Established in 1996 and headquartered in Guangzhou, China, the company was formerly known as Goal Rise Logistics (China) Holdings Limited, changing its name to Yues International Holdings Group Limited in May 2022.
